summary: Ford Credit Auto Receivables Two LLC, as depositor, filed a routine Form 8-K on September 28, 2026, in connection with the issuance of asset-backed notes by Ford Credit Auto Owner Trust 2026-C under a September 22, 2026 prospectus. The filing satisfies an undertaking to furnish unqualified legality and federal income tax opinions from Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP, attached as Exhibits 5.1 and 8.1. No transaction terms, equity stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor engagement, or special-situation mechanics are stated; Ford Motor Credit Company LLC is sponsor. This is an ordinary ABS shelf takedown, precluding a special-situations classification and offering no risk-arb angle.
